notes: TickAssist 5. Lite can export the day's session (tickets, photos, lists, macros) as a .db file for the full edition's Merge Databases (Ticket Repository > Export for full TickAssist). The update address defaults to https://github.com/Ankokomen/Tickassist-Updates. Romexis versions are exempt from sheet verification (free text with suggestions, added on save, left out of Import from sheets). A fresh copy starts with the Imaging Package sheet and its column mapping already set.
